extra.data:guide-pages: The prerendered Cruising Guide pages /guides/<slug>.html and /es/guides/<slug>.html, written from platform_state.guides by runGuidesPrerender (not in git)

extra.flow:guide-scores-match-conga-ratings: The hand-written "My Score" numbers in the 30-largest-ships guide (EN and ES) must equal the live Conga Line ratings Room Concierge shows
